## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A roadmap item with default implementer policy is dispatched to the queue...

The system SHALL ensure that a roadmap item with default implementer policy is dispatched to the queue without requiring its owner to start a session.

#### Scenario: A roadmap item with default implementer policy is dispatched to the queue...

WHEN `queue-dispatch-owner-acceptance` is implemented
THEN A roadmap item with default implementer policy is dispatched to the queue without requiring its owner to start a session.

### Requirement: A queue-implemented PR requests review from the item owner and cannot be...

The system SHALL ensure that a queue-implemented PR requests review from the item owner and cannot be merged without the owner's acceptance.

#### Scenario: A queue-implemented PR requests review from the item owner and cannot be...

WHEN `queue-dispatch-owner-acceptance` is implemented
THEN A queue-implemented PR requests review from the item owner and cannot be merged without the owner's acceptance.

### Requirement: Claimed, in-flight implementation is visible from the git remote alone via a...

The system SHALL ensure that claimed, in-flight implementation is visible from the git remote alone via a draft PR naming the item and claim time.

#### Scenario: Claimed, in-flight implementation is visible from the git remote alone via a...

WHEN `queue-dispatch-owner-acceptance` is implemented
THEN Claimed, in-flight implementation is visible from the git remote alone via a draft PR naming the item and claim time.

### Requirement: An owner rejection is recorded with its reason and linked to the contract,...

The system SHALL ensure that an owner rejection is recorded with its reason and linked to the contract, so spec gaps surfaced by rejection become amendments.

#### Scenario: An owner rejection is recorded with its reason and linked to the contract,...

WHEN `queue-dispatch-owner-acceptance` is implemented
THEN An owner rejection is recorded with its reason and linked to the contract, so spec gaps surfaced by rejection become amendments.

### Requirement: In solo mode the sole principal is both owner and acceptor and no additional...

The system SHALL ensure that in solo mode the sole principal is both owner and acceptor and no additional acceptance gate appears.

#### Scenario: In solo mode the sole principal is both owner and acceptor and no additional...

WHEN `queue-dispatch-owner-acceptance` is implemented
THEN In solo mode the sole principal is both owner and acceptor and no additional acceptance gate appears.
